{{Otheruses|Level 3}}
The '''Energy shield level 3''' was a sophisticated [[droid shield]] designed for top quality [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. This item provided superior energy protection to any droid with the necessary software to install it. Unfortunately, the power drain during its use was significant, therefore, the units needed to be replaced regularly.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
